iterations.xml:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
                  id="Definitions_OEE"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/oee">

  <bpmn:message id="Message_OEEBelowThreshold" name="OEE below threshold"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_MachineRestarted" name="Machine restarted"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_MachineDisconnected" name="Machine disconnected"/>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_OEE" name="OEE" isExecutable="false">

    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_OEE" name="Process started">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_StartToMerge</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Merge_Measurement" name="Measurement cycle">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_StartToMerge</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_DefaultToMerge</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_RestartToMerge</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_MergeToCollect</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_CollectData" name="Collect machine data">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_MergeToCollect</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_CollectToCalculate</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:serviceTask>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_CalculateOEE" name="Calculate OEE">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_CollectToCalculate</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_CalculateToSplit</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_OEE_Check" name="OEE below threshold?"
                           default="Flow_DefaultToMerge">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_CalculateToSplit</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_BelowThreshold</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_DefaultToMerge</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_StopMachine" name="Stop machine">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_BelowThreshold</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_StopToEmail</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:serviceTask>

    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendEmail" name="Send email to engineer"
                   messageRef="Message_OEEBelowThreshold">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_StopToEmail</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_EmailToRestart</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>

    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_MachineRestarted" name="Machine restarted">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_EmailToRestart</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_RestartToMerge</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_MachineRestarted" messageRef="Message_MachineRestarted"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>

    <bpmn:subProcess id="SubProcess_Disconnected" name="Machine disconnected" triggeredByEvent="true">
      <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_Disconnected" name="Machine disconnected" isInterrupting="true">
        <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_DisconnectToEnd</bpmn:outgoing>
        <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_MachineDisconnected" messageRef="Message_MachineDisconnected"/>
      </bpmn:startEvent>
      <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_ProcessStopped" name="Process stopped">
        <bpmn:incoming>Flow_DisconnectToEnd</bpmn:incoming>
        <bpmn:terminateEventDefinition id="TED_ProcessStopped"/>
      </bpmn:endEvent>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_DisconnectToEnd" sourceRef="StartEvent_Disconnected" targetRef="EndEvent_ProcessStopped"/>
    </bpmn:subProcess>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_StartToMerge" sourceRef="StartEvent_OEE" targetRef="Gateway_Merge_Measurement"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_MergeToCollect" sourceRef="Gateway_Merge_Measurement" targetRef="Task_CollectData"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CollectToCalculate" sourceRef="Task_CollectData" targetRef="Task_CalculateOEE"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CalculateToSplit" sourceRef="Task_CalculateOEE" targetRef="Gateway_OEE_Check"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_BelowThreshold" sourceRef="Gateway_OEE_Check" targetRef="Task_StopMachine">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${oee < oeeThreshold}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_DefaultToMerge" sourceRef="Gateway_OEE_Check" targetRef="Gateway_Merge_Measurement"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_StopToEmail" sourceRef="Task_StopMachine" targetRef="Task_SendEmail"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_EmailToRestart" sourceRef="Task_SendEmail" targetRef="Event_MachineRestarted"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RestartToMerge" sourceRef="Event_MachineRestarted" targetRef="Gateway_Merge_Measurement"/>

  </bpmn:process>

</bpmn:definitions>
